TEXT: [FI] At night, a couple of days after the date in Odaiba...
[FI] I was feeling lonely, playing galge in my room...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Can't believe I would sink so low.

[FI] But I had no choice, really. Kirino forced it on me, 
saying the game was godly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] She'll get angry if I turned her down...

[FI] And then my girlfriend, whom Kirino so loves, 
turned into some angel of death?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That is something that has to be avoided at all 
costs.

[FI] ...Well, playing galge has more or less become 
normal in my life by now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Still, compared to the heroine in this game, I think 
my Ayase is a lot cuter.

[FI] She really is just like an angel... Damn. I suddenly 
hunger to hear Ayase's voice right this instant.

[FI] --Maybe I should call her? What if she's thinking the 
same? Yeah right. Ahahaha!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is it Ayase?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] G-Good evening, Onii-san. I'm sorry to call you so 
late at night.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No, actually, I was just thinking I wanted to hear 
your voice, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I-Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So, did you want something?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] C-Can't I call you without wanting something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Not at all! Of course you can! In fact, please do!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Really? ...I'm glad.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, but this time there is something I wanted. I 
wanted to ask you something...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sure, no matter what it is, I'll hear it all.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Really? O-Okay... Onii-san, on the next holiday, um... 
a-are you free?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=28]I'm free! I'm super free![/font_size]　Why do you 
ask?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Um, you see... W-Why don't we go to the beach?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] T-The beach?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=18]I was thinking we should take a day trip to Atami...[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]Yes! I humbly accept the invitation![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] O-Okay... I'm glad.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But why Atami, all of a sudden?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] There's no deep meaning behind it. I just wanted to 
go to the beach with you, Onii-san... But it would be 
embarrassing if it was somewhere close.

[FI] I see. True, if it's somewhere around here, there's 
always the risk of running into someone we know.

[FI] Still, going on a trip, huh... Just the two of us, for a 
whole day...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Alright. Where do we meet up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] U-Um, Onii-san? It's going to be for [font_size=28]the 
whole day![/font_size]

[FI] Um, Ayase-san? Why are you emphasizing the fact 
that it's for the whole day?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I know that, so no need to repeat it.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] O-Oh...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Then let's meet in front of the station. That way we 
won't have to worry about missing the train either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Got it.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Okay then, good night.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, good night.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ayase was pretty tense there, huh.

[FI] Then again, she just asked her boyfriend out on a 
trip, so it's only natural to feel that way.

[FI] ...Wait. Since this trip is going to take all day, does 
she mean... Or maybe...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, but she might...?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san... I don't... want to go back home tonight...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]Wooooooooooooooaaaaaaaaaaaaahh![/font_size]

[FI] Faced with that prospect, I couldn't help but start 
violently headbutting the wall.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Pipe down! What time do you think it is?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-Sorry!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Really, you're too much.

[FI] Kirino's probably still angry despite my apology, 
since she suddenly burst into my room.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] If you do that again, I'll tell Ayase you tried to 
assault me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=44]Please don't![/font_size]
[FI] If you do that, we're both done for!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Oh? You're actually playing that game?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah, I guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Good boy. Tell me what you thought of it once 
you've finished.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Fine, just get out already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Yeah, yeah. But seriously, no more banging on the 
wall.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Look, I said I'm sorry...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Night.

[FI] In the end, having my delusions about Ayase on the 
trip completely shattered, I continued playing galge 
all night.

[FI] ...Strange. I'm supposed to be happy, but I just feel 
empty...
